title: Lower ME: Squat
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Goblet Squat w/ Heartbeat × 8 · Inchworm Push-Up × 6 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side
jumps: Back Squat 3 · 3-sec pause @ RPE 8 → Box Jump 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Isometric wk 1: dead-stop 3-sec pause at the bottom, no bounce · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · every jump max intent
Quick off the floor, stiff ankles
strength: Slow, hold a rack or wall
note: Isometric phase: 3-second dead-stop pause at the bottom of every main-lift rep. Heavier than last week.
